title: Sparse Incident-Cluster Learning for 12-hour Port Flood Pre-warning in Digital-Twin Analytics
abstract: arXiv:2609.06109v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Port flood digital twins require analytics that warn operators before disruption, but official warning incidents are often few and adjacent observations are temporally dependent. Row-level classification can therefore overstate performance by placing windows from the same event in both model-development and evaluation data. We formulate 12-hour port flood pre-warning as an incident-cluster learning problem and evaluate a digital-twin analytics module using eight-point water-level histories, prediction-time contextual covariates, and interpretable short-window dynamics. The protocol combines fold-specific sparse feature selection, warning-cluster grouping, negative-label controls, 100-repeat random top-k controls, and alert-episode evaluation. translated_title: 面向数字孪生分析的12小时港口洪水预警的稀疏事件聚类学习
translated_abstract: 港口洪水数字孪生需要能够在中断发生前向运营者发出预警的分析方法，但官方预警事件通常稀少，且相邻观测在时间上相互依赖。因此，行级分类方法可能因将同一事件的窗口同时置于模型开发数据和评估数据中而高估性能。我们将12小时港口洪水预警表述为一个事件聚类学习问题，并使用八点水位历史、预测时刻上下文协变量以及可解释的短窗口动态来评估数字孪生分析模块。该评估协议结合了特定折的稀疏特征选择、预警聚类分组、负标签控制、100次重复的随机top-k控制以及警报事件评估。利物浦是主要的四聚类案例研究，同时使用统一的Humber/Hull代理数据和Wessex South数据进行协议迁移性检验。在利物浦各折中，top-10 ElasticNet模型……
tldr: 该论文将12小时港口洪水预警建模为事件聚类学习问题，通过结合稀疏特征选择、预警聚类分组及多重控制手段避免因时间数据泄漏导致的高估性能，并以利物浦为案例进行了数字孪生分析验证。
en_tdlr: The paper formulates 12-hour port flood pre-warning as an incident-cluster learning problem, combining fold-specific sparse feature selection, warning-cluster grouping, and multiple controls to avoid performance overestimation from temporal data leakage, validated through a Liverpool digital-twin case study.
